about:
REO Plastics Inc operates from Maple Grove, Minnesota. The company was founded by Robert E. O'Connor, whose initials gave the firm its name. The founding year is not publicly disclosed, and ownership details have not been specified.

The company specializes in custom plastic injection molding, offering end-to-end services from product development and design for manufacturability through prototype to production manufacturing. Its capabilities include plastic machining (CNC milling and EDM), plastic material decoration, assembly and verification testing, and stocking/fulfillment. Equipment includes a 950-ton injection molding press, a CNC electric robot for molding automation, and advanced automation systems. Facility size and employee count are not disclosed.

Customers range from large manufacturing firms to small startups, with testimonials citing long-term partnerships spanning over 25 years. The company serves clients in sectors requiring precision plastic components, though specific industry verticals are not listed.

REO Plastics emphasizes its core values of quality, service, and productivity, aiming to build long-term partnerships. It differentiates itself through flexible, end-to-end injection molding services, complimentary value-added services such as machining and decoration, and advanced automation equipment that enables it to handle projects of varying size and complexity.
